title: Set 244

sentences.ko: 자기 전에 영상 하나만 보려고 했는데 다음 영상이 계속 저절로 나오는 거야. 정신 차리고 보니까 거의 새벽 세 시더라. 그래서 오늘 좀 좀비 상태야.
sentences.text: I only meant to watch one video before bed, but it just kept playing the next one, and by the time I looked up it was almost three. So yeah, I'm kind of a zombie today.

alts.text: Was gonna watch one video before bed, but it kept autoplaying the next one, and next thing I know it's almost three. So yeah, total zombie today.

I had intended to watch only one video before going to bed, but the next one kept playing automatically, and by the time I noticed, it was nearly three o'clock. As a result, I am rather exhausted today.

sentences.note: **by the time I looked up** 은 정신 차리고 보니, 고개를 들어 보니 하는 뜻이에요. **I'm kind of a zombie** 는 너무 피곤해서 멍한 상태를 말해요.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

sentences.ko: 나 이제 슬슬 가 봐야겠다. 베이비시터한테 열 시까지 간다고 했거든. 또 늦으면 이제 돈 더 달라고 할 거야. 그래도 오늘 진짜 좋았어, 얘들아.
sentences.text: I should probably get going, because I told the babysitter we'd be back by ten, and if I'm late again she's going to start charging me extra. But this was really great, you guys.

alts.text: Gotta run, I told the sitter we'd be home by ten, and if I'm late again she's gonna start charging me extra. This was awesome though, guys.
I am afraid I should be leaving, as I told the babysitter we would return by ten, and if I am late again, she will begin charging me extra. However, I truly enjoyed this evening with all of you.

sentences.note: **get going** 은 자리를 뜨다, 가 보다 라는 뜻이에요. **charging me extra** 는 나한테 돈을 더 받는다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 저녁 모임에서 먼저 일어날 구실 만들기

sentences.ko: 미안, 알람이 안 울렸어. 아니, 울리긴 했는데 자다가 내가 끈 것 같아. 끈 기억이 전혀 없거든.
sentences.text: Sorry, my alarm didn't go off. Well, okay, it went off, but I guess I turned it off in my sleep, because I don't remember doing that at all.

alts.text: My bad, alarm didn't go off. Okay, it did, but I must've shut it off in my sleep, 'cause I don't remember that at all.
I apologize, my alarm did not go off. To be precise, it did go off, but I believe I turned it off while I was asleep, because I have no memory of doing so.

sentences.note: **go off** 는 알람이 울리다 라는 뜻이에요. **in my sleep** 은 자다가, 잠결에 라는 뜻이에요.

sentences.ko: 내가 뭘 찾을 때마다 너는 그거 벌써 봤다고 하잖아. 그러니까 그냥 네가 골라. 불평 안 할게, 약속해. 잠들기 전에 뭐라도 보고 싶어서 그래.
sentences.text: Every time I find something, you say you've already seen it, so why don't you just pick? I promise I won't complain, I just want to watch something before I fall asleep.

alts.text: Whatever I find, you've already seen it, so why don't you pick? I won't complain, promise. I just wanna watch something before I pass out.

Every time I suggest something, you tell me you have already seen it, so perhaps you could choose instead. I assure you I will not complain. I would simply like to watch something before I fall asleep.

sentences.note: **why don't you just pick?** 은 그냥 네가 고르지 그래 하고 권하는 말이에요. **I promise I won't complain** 은 불평 안 한다고 약속할 때 써요.

sentences.ko: 윗집에 꼬마가 하나 있는데 저녁 내내 이리저리 뛰어다녀. 애니까 이해는 하는데 꼭 부츠 신고 뛰는 것 같아. 유난 떠는 이웃은 되기 싫은데 이번 주 내내 밤마다 머리가 아팠어.
sentences.text: The people upstairs have a little kid who runs back and forth all evening, and I get it, he's a kid, but it sounds like he's wearing boots. I don't want to be that neighbor, but I've had a headache every night this week.

alts.text: Kid upstairs runs around all evening. I get it, he's a kid, but it's like he's in boots. Don't wanna be that neighbor, but I've had a headache every night this week.

The residents upstairs have a young child who runs back and forth throughout the evening. I understand that he is a child, but it sounds as though he is wearing boots. I do not wish to be a difficult neighbor, but I have had a headache every night this week.

sentences.note: **I get it** 은 이해는 한다는 뜻이에요. **be that neighbor** 는 남들이 꺼리는 그런 유난스러운 이웃이 된다는 말이에요.

reviewed: 2번 한국어 '돈을 더 받기 시작할 거야'가 번역투라 '돈 더 달라고 할 거야'로 자연스럽게 고침
4번 formal 'would you prefer to choose?'는 고르라고 권하는 원문 말투에서 벗어나 'perhaps you could choose'로 고침
5번 casual이 원문과 거의 같아서 더 짧고 줄인 구어로 다시 씀
5번 한국어 '까다로운 이웃'은 that neighbor의 느낌과 달라 '유난 떠는 이웃'으로 고침
